items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 31:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the illumination of the Reshimo from above downward? The Mochin of YESHSUT, which prevail on weekdays, are discerned as the illumination of the Reshimo from above downward, because the Nukva does not receive them from the head of ZA in its place, but by the bowing of the head of ZA to the aspect of his HGT, where Jacob and Rachel stand, at the time of the ascent of the NHY of ZA to his HGT, and the Nukva receives the Mochin from Jacob alone. And since the Mochin come in the bowing of the head to the place of the NHY, which became HGT, therefore they are discerned as the illumination of the Reshimo drawn to the place of the Nukva, for the Nukva does not receive from their place in the GAR of ZA. (Item 11).
